# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The most recent commit at which the repository is generally the most stable & efficient version of the delivered software, unless an unexpected issue conflicts with user experience until resolved.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report unexpected behaviours [here](https://github.com/kefohaine/kefoCloud/issues) only if it:
- Is not documented in the repository
- Is not already discussed as an issue
- Is not negligible to user experience
